rfp_requirements.title: Describe security program review and update process and frequency
rfp_requirements.description: Describe the process the organization follows, and how frequently, to review and update its security program and safeguards.

rfp_requirements.title: Detail disciplinary/sanction policy for security policy violations
rfp_requirements.description: Detail the disciplinary or sanction policy established for personnel and contractors who have violated security policies and procedures.

rfp_requirements.title: Apply least privilege when provisioning access
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure the principle of least privilege when provisioning access to organizational assets.

rfp_requirements.title: Conduct periodic reviews of access
rfp_requirements.description: Conduct periodic reviews of access authorizations and controls.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe access granting and review processes
rfp_requirements.description: Describe the organization's processes and methods for granting access, reviewing access, and documenting the review, and whether access is centrally managed.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe remote access authentication mechanisms
rfp_requirements.description: If personnel and/or contractors are provided remote access to the internal network, describe authentication and authorization mechanisms and use of MFA for remote access.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement system hardening configuration standards
rfp_requirements.description: Implement configuration standards consistent with industry-accepted system hardening standards and address known security vulnerabilities for all system components.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe baseline configuration management processes
rfp_requirements.description: Describe processes employed to establish and maintain baseline security configuration settings, referencing standards such as CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs, and component vendor security configuration guides.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe central management of production endpoints
rfp_requirements.description: State whether all endpoints in or with access to the production environment are centrally managed and explain.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe data exfiltration limits on endpoints
rfp_requirements.description: Describe how data exfiltration of sensitive data is limited from endpoints in or with access to the production environment.

rfp_requirements.title: List and describe ICS/SCADA/OT systems and security
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, list and describe any ICS/SCADA/OT systems used across the organization and detail how those systems are secured physically, administratively, and technically.

rfp_requirements.title: Securely Configure IoT Assets
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure the secure configuration of IoT assets.

rfp_requirements.title: Establish Mobile Device Authorization Requirements
rfp_requirements.description: Establish requirements for authorization to use mobile devices for organizational business purposes.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe BYOD Network Access Management
rfp_requirements.description: Indicate whether the organization allows BYOD devices to connect to its internal network and, if so, how BYOD are managed so they do not introduce additional risks.

rfp_requirements.title: Govern statutory, regulatory, contractual, and policy compliance
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must develop, implement, and govern processes to ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, contractual, and internal policy obligations.

rfp_requirements.title: Indicate third-party security audits and last audit dates
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must indicate all third-party security audits (CJIS, Social Security Admin., IRS-1075, FedRAMP, FISMA, SOC2, PCI-DSS, Other) and subsequent last audit dates conducted to ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations and contractual requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Specify compliance frameworks and provide documentation
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must specify all compliance frameworks and standards followed (e.g., GDPR, COBIT, ISO) and provide documentation for all IT operational, security, and privacy-related standards, certifications, and/or regulations for which the organization or product/system/application/service is compliant.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure Qualified Maintenance Personnel
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure individuals conducting maintenance operations are qualified and trustworthy.

rfp_requirements.title: List Threat Intelligence Sources
rfp_requirements.description: List and describe the threat intelligence sources subscribed to or followed in order to keep abreast of potential security vulnerabilities and threats.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe patch and vulnerability remediation prioritization
rfp_requirements.description: Describe how patches and vulnerability remediation processes are prioritized, and how remediation results are documented and verified.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe API security
rfp_requirements.description: Describe how API security is maintained including storage of API keys and support for IP whitelisting for API access.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe web application user authentication
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, describe how users are authenticated for web applications, including password complexity requirements and protection, and SAML/SSO/MFA support options.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe additional user authentication controls
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, describe additional user authentication controls including, but not limited to, IP whitelisting and geofencing.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement project and resource management controls throughout SDLC
rfp_requirements.description: The organization ensures that controls necessary to appropriately manage risks are accounted for and implemented throughout the System Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

rfp_requirements.title: Describe validation of third-party compliance
rfp_requirements.description: Describe the processes utilized to validate third-party service providers' compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and contractual requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe continuity of operations processes and plans
rfp_requirements.description: Describe the processes and plans implemented to ensure continuity of operations for the organization.

rfp_requirements.title: Disable access and recover assets upon termination
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must disable system access for terminated personnel and collect all organization-owned assets prior to the individual's departure.

rfp_requirements.title: Identify which parts of security are managed in each component
Provide read-only access by security group
Provide update access by security group
Do not store/transfer NJ data outside the United States
Complete corrective actions based on root cause of Breach
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must complete all corrective actions as reasonably determined by Contractor based on the root cause of the Breach of Security.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure third-party interconnection security
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure third party interconnection security.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain contacts with law enforcement cybersecurity units
rfp_requirements.description: Maintain contacts with law enforcement cybersecurity units.

rfp_requirements.title: Include security requirements in position descriptions
rfp_requirements.description: Position descriptions must include appropriate language regarding each role's security requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Do not disclose Breach publicly without State consent
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall not provide any other notification or disclosure to the public regarding such Breach of Security without the prior written consent of the State, unless legally required.

rfp_requirements.title: Assist State in breach investigation and remediation
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must assist the State in investigating, remedying, and taking any other action the State deems necessary regarding any Breach of Security.

rfp_requirements.title: Follow State instructions regarding affected Personal Data
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must follow all instructions provided by the State relating to the Personal Data affected or potentially affected by the Breach.

rfp_requirements.title: Take actions to prevent future breaches
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must take actions necessary to prevent future Breaches of Security.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify State of third-party legal process
rfp_requirements.description: Unless prohibited by statute or court order, Contractor must notify the State of any third party legal process relating to a Breach of Security, including any governmental legal process.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement technical remote access controls
rfp_requirements.description: Implement technical security controls such as encryption, multi-factor authentication, IP whitelisting, and geo-fencing.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement project and resource management security controls
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must ensure controls necessary to manage risks are accounted for and implemented throughout the Contract term.

rfp_requirements.title: Non-Discrimination in Employment
rfp_requirements.description: Do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, and take affirmative action to ensure applicants are employed and treated without regard to these characteristics.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement a data protection policy
rfp_requirements.description: Security categorization controls must include implementing a data protection policy.

rfp_requirements.title: Complete State's Security Controls Checklist
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must disclose its non-proprietary security processes and technical limitations by completing the State's Security Controls Checklist or equivalent system security document.

rfp_requirements.title: Remove Contractor representatives upon State request
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must, upon State request, remove any Contractor representative the State believes is detrimental to the working relationship; immediately if a potential security violation is signified.

rfp_requirements.title: Data protection as integral part of business activities
rfp_requirements.description: Protection of personal privacy and data shall be an integral part of the business activities of the Contractor to ensure no inappropriate or unauthorized use of State Data at any time. Contractor shall safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of State Data.

rfp_requirements.title: Administrative, technical and organizational security measures
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall implement and maintain appropriate administrative, technical and organizational security measures to safeguard against unauthorized access, disclosure or theft of Personal Data and Non-Public Data, in accordance with recognized good industry practice and not less stringent than meas

rfp_requirements.title: Encrypt Personal Data at rest and in transit
rfp_requirements.description: All Personal Data shall be encrypted at rest and in transit with controlled access. Contractor is responsible for encryption of the Personal Data, and the level of protection and encryption shall be identified and made part of the contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Encrypt Non-Public Data at rest and in transit
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall encrypt all Non-Public Data at rest and in transit, and the level of protection and encryption shall be identified and made part of the contract.

rfp_requirements.title: No Personal Data on Mobile Devices unless FIPS 140-2 encrypted
rfp_requirements.description: Personal Data shall not be stored on Mobile Devices. Where required, Contractor shall ensure the Mobile Device's hard drive is encrypted consistent with validated cryptography standards referenced in FIPS 140-2, Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules, for all Personal Data.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify State of Breach of Security within 24 hours
rfp_requirements.description: If the Contractor confirms or reasonably believes a Breach of Security has occurred, it must immediately notify the State contact within 24 hours (or shorter if required by law).

rfp_requirements.title: Implement remedial measures after incident
rfp_requirements.description: Following a Security Incident or Breach of Security, Contractor must promptly implement necessary remedial measures and document responsive actions, including any post-incident review.

rfp_requirements.title: Detail mechanisms securing data at rest, in transit, and in use
rfp_requirements.description: Detail the mechanisms used to secure data at rest, data in transit, and data in use.

rfp_requirements.title: Forward investigation records to Union within 24 hours
rfp_requirements.description: At the conclusion of a disciplinary investigation, the Employer shall forward all written statements and other records to the Union within 24 hours of completion of the investigation, but no later than the Employer's answer to the grievance, excluding privileged documents.

rfp_requirements.title: Sign and date NDA for the Vendor
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must sign and date the NDA, and provide printed name and title of signatory.

rfp_requirements.title: Acknowledge State may release Questionnaire pursuant to law/subpoena/court order
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor acknowledges NJOHSP or the Division may release the Security Questionnaire if directed by operation of law, lawfully issued subpoena, or ruling by a court or arbitrator of competent jurisdiction; the State will notify Vendor at the address listed of such ruling/directive upon being made aware

rfp_requirements.title: Governing law and venue - New Jersey
rfp_requirements.description: The Agreement is governed by New Jersey law without reference to conflict of laws principles, and any legal action regarding the Agreement must be filed in the appropriate Division of the New Jersey Superior Court.

rfp_requirements.title: Do not revise standard NDA without State approval
rfp_requirements.description: Any revision to the standard NDA by the Vendor that was not approved and accepted by the State during the Question and Answer period shall render the Agreement VOID.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Third-Party Organization Profile
rfp_requirements.description: Provide organization name, mailing address, city, state, zip/postal code, country, and organization website URL.

rfp_requirements.title: Answer all controls and questions for engagement scope
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor is required to provide answers for all controls and questions as they apply to the scope of the engagement with the State of New Jersey.

Dear Ms. Grabuloff,
Parsons Transportation Group Inc. (Parsons) is pleased to provide this proposal to the Pennsylvania Department of
Transportation (PennDOT), Bureau of Office Services, in response to Request for Proposal (RFP) Number 3522R12
for Emissions Program Management.
Our commitment to PennDOT is to continue delivering an effective Pennsylvania Vehicle Emissions Inspection and
Maintenance Program and to innovate responsibly to move the Program forward. Building on our past performance,
we will implement new, cloud-based VIID systems and improved auditing infrastructure that efficiently gets Program
data to PennDOT. Our upgrades to the e-SAFETY system will support the enhanced safety inspection Program
compliance. We will upgrade our call center solution with new technology using ZenDesk and AmazonConnect as
the backbone of the system.
Our Program Mana

auditor teams, support teams, and subcontractors are in place. In this challenging
labor market, we do not anticipate any staffing impacts as your selected vendor in the new contract. Upon Notice to
Proceed, with no transitional risk to current operations, we will begin the implementation tasks to fulfill all RFP
requirements.
Parsons continues its commitment to Small Diverse Businesses and Small Businesses for this procurement.
Additionally, we have added two Veteran Business Enterprises to our team, 1Alpha Consulting to bolster our
motorist compliance activities and Berry Solutions Group for our information and education development and to
provide enhanced auditor training.
Offeror Responsibilities and Exceptions to the RFP Requirements
All information submitted pertains exclusively to Parsons Transportation Group Inc. as a subsidiary of Parsons

of the contractual provisions outlined in the RFP.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
WORKING WITH PENNDOT TO MOVE THE I/M
PROGRAM FORWARD THROUGH ADAPTABILITY
AND INNOVATION
Parsons is uniquely positioned to deliver each requirement PennDOT has outlined for the new contract, enhancing what
works and innovating for the future. We’re fully committed to:
Applying innovation and advanced technology tailored to Pennsylvania’s Program
Ensuring station compliance
Employing advanced Cybersecurity protocols to protect against security threats
Eliminating PennDOT’s transition risk
Parsons appreciates PennDOT’s business. Throughout our response, we demonstrate our depth of experience, our
reliability, our compliance, and our adaptability. We have unmatched knowledge of PennDOT’s emissions and safety
programs, and we know what you require from your vendor. Most importantly, we won’t rest on our laurels; in this new
contract, we will demonstrate to PennDOT that we are the best vendor to bring the Program into the future.
Highlights of Parsons’ Technical Proposal
Secure Data and Information Management Systems. Our systems are reliable, and we are proud of the 99.99% uptime
of our Pennsylvania VIID. Program downtime is simply unacceptable to us, and our experien

nfrastructure that affords PennDOT the confidence to move forward. Protecting
data and information from loss, intrusion, and sophisticated cyber-attacks is critical to our data and management
systems. Our dedicated Pennsylvania team includes cybersecurity professionals, reinforced by a company-wide
Cybersecurity Practice that serves federal and state governments. Across our entire company, we integrate data and
information security from the ground up through system design, system development, and day-to-day operations and
maintenance. The Pennsylvania VIID has never had a security or performance issue, and we will keep it that way.
Mindful Innovation. To maintain critical service continuity, and with PennDOT’s approval, we will migrate all systems to
the Amazon Web Service (AWS) cloud environment. The system upgrade will provide efficient change management
implementation to adapt to future Program enhancements. The cloud-based VIID will include expanded reporting and
data management features along with robust scalability, security, and recovery. The upgraded system will allow
PennDOT faster access to overt and covert audit data for the I/M and safety and enhanced safety programs. P

AWS Partner Solutions Provider, AWS DevOps Competency Partner, and AWS Advanced Tier Services
Partner, and holds other designations. Our engineers and in-house security experts have more than 100 AWS
certifications, and Parsons has secured AWS’s commitment to support our Pennsylvania solution during our
implementation and ongoing utilization of AWS/AWS products. Our experience moving the Ontario DriveON program to
AWS allows us to implement our proposed update to the PA I/M Program VIID securely, without interruption in service
or uptime. We will upgrade our call center solution with new technology using ZenDesk and AmazonConnect as the
backbone of the system.
Station Compliance. Our operational goals align with PennDOT’s focus on station and inspector compliance. We
recognize the Program’s integrity and customer confidence are rooted in ensuring compliance. We will continually
adapt to improve our audit and hearing processes through innovation and enhanced auditor training. Parsons has in-
house professional oversight personnel with experience in the Pennsylvania Program. In this challenging labor market,
our teams are fully staffed, trained, and dependable.
Executive Summary ES-1

Equipment Certification. Parsons has certified all equipment used by the stations, from the days of tailpipe and
dynamometer testing to today’s OBD equipment. Our experienced and knowledgeable equipment certification team is
ready to support tomorrow’s vehicle communication protocols. We are not an equipment provider in Pennsylvania, and
this separation allows us to conduct impartial equipment testing, which is key to Program success and integrity. We
reliably ensure equipment performance that promotes consumer confidence.
Vendor Compliance. PennDOT expects its vendors to comply with all contract requirements. As part of Parsons’
compliance commitment, we will introduce our Service Level Tracking Application (SLTA) in AWS. The SLTA provides a
summary of the service level agreements that PennDOT has clearly stated in this RFP and identifies the delivery of the
task required, providing PennDOT with a way to ensure we meet our contractual obligations.
We will augment our compliance validation with professionals from Michael Baker International. They will provide third-
party validation of completed audit numbers and support evaluation of the I/M Program and oversight activities. They

PennDOT │ RFP # 3522R12 Compliant, Experienced
field use. In 2020, we reacted and adapted to the COVID-19 pandemic, successfully delivering all Program requirements
despite the mandated closures. In 2021, we collaborated with you to implement important OBD system changes that
improved emissions testing and Program integrity. In 2023, we increased overt audit staff to meet your need for
increased safety station oversight. We have demonstrated our adaptability and expertise. Our understanding of the
Program will benefit you in the new contract through:
§ Trusted relationships—we’ve established constructive relationships with both PennDOT staff and the inspection
industry who trust us to communicate and resolve I/M Program issues.
§ Operational continuity—our experienced team will manage the daily operational tasks of the I/M Program.
§ Innovation—we’ve implemented an electronic audit application that leverages touchscreen laptops, electronic
signature capture, and VIID integration to eliminate paper overt audit reports submitted to PennDOT.
§ Enhanced cybersecurity protection—we scan systems supporting our VIID using the same technolo

§ Covert audit integrity—our undercover vehicle dealership, approved by the Department of State and PennDOT,
allows us to acquire vehicles without exposure to the inspection industry and the public.
§ Institutional knowledge—our knowledge of your EPA-required reporting needs provides an accurate and detailed
evaluation of the I/M Program.
§ Internal training resources—as the only PennDOT-certified Vehicle Emission Inspection School (VEMIS E200), we
train PennDOT Program staff in-house, preventing oversight staff from training with I/M personnel they may
eventually audit.
§ Minimal risk during the transition—our current VIID is already in place and functioning and we have the necessary

§ Proven I&E experience—we’ve managed successful I&E efforts in Pennsylvania, communicating with the inspection

teaming with two Harrisburg-based firms to help fulfill the I&E Program.
§ Experienced Court of Common Pleas

and expert testimony in support of PennDOT sanctions against stations and inspectors.
§ Program continuity—we have the knowledge to support all three equipment platforms, four manufacturers, and two
equipment specifications and the infrastructure to support legacy dial-up connectivity.
Parsons ensures a risk-free transition and reliability for PennDOT to ensure the
I/M Program’s exceptional operational performance and customer service.

Parsons is a global, 18,000+-person company with 79 years of experience supporting complex programs for its clients.
We entered the vehicle inspection industry in 1984, providing referee services for the California Bureau of Automotive
Repair; our vehicle inspection team began working with PennDOT at the Program’s inception that led to public safety and
a cleaner environment. We deliver cybersecurity, advanced technology solutions, and other services to federal, regional,
and local government agencies and national and international private industrial customers. Our agile and innovative
approach enables us to deliver solutions that satisfy our client’s current and future initiatives.
